summary: Completed testing of the ticker config fix - practices filter now works correctly. The bug was fixed by moving tickerFilters storage to a separate /api/league-data/tickerConfig endpoint instead of websiteStyle (which was stripping object values). Both backend API tests and frontend UI tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix correctly separates tickerConfig from websiteStyle - tickerConfig is now stored independently at /api/league-data/tickerConfig
TickerManager.js correctly loads config from the new endpoint and auto-saves on filter change
EventsTicker.js reads tickerConfig prop and applies filters correctly
App.js loads tickerConfig as separate state and passes it to Layout and AdminPage

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All filter toggles and ticker display verified

seed_data_creation: Used existing practice events including 'Test Team Practice'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ticker config is now stored separately at /api/league-data/tickerConfig. The TickerManager admin UI is accessed via Admin Portal > Settings > Website Design > Event Ticker tab. Practice events appear/disappear correctly based on the practices filter setting.

GET_tickerConfig.details: Returns stored config with tickerFilters object containing all filter keys (games, tournaments, practices, meetings, social, other)

POST_tickerConfig.details: Saves config correctly including tickerFilters object - no longer stripped by sanitizer

practices_filter_false.details: When practices=false, practice events disappear from ticker. Ticker shows filtered:4 instead of filtered:5

practices_filter_true.details: When practices=true, practice events appear in ticker with 'PRACTICE' label

TickerManager_UI_loads.details: TickerManager at Admin Portal > Settings > Event Ticker loads with correct filter states from API

TickerManager_auto_save.details: Clicking filter toggle immediately saves to /api/league-data/tickerConfig endpoint

lookback_lookforward.details: tickerLookBack=7 and tickerLookForward=120 settings persist correctly

ticker_display.details: Homepage ticker displays correct events based on filter settings

screenshots_taken: .screenshots/ticker_homepage.png - Homepage with ticker showing PRACTICE event
